segments.source: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

segments.source: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

segments.source: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

segments.source: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
segments.reference: Aru bura khan to golti nathaka hobo lage, aru ekjon maiki laga mota hobo lage, aru tai laga bacha khan bhi adat biya aru kotha namana eneka nohobo lage.

segments.source: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;
segments.reference: Kelemane ekjon girja laga cholawta to Isor laga ghor sa karone eku napuncha nathakibo lage. Aru tai ekjon nijor khushi te jai thaka, aru joldi khong kora, aru misa kotha, aru jhagara kora, aru lalchi nohobo lage.

segments.source: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

segments.reference: Tai hosa biswas kotha ke thik dhori thaka, aru manu ke Isor laga kotha to bhal pora bujhai dibo para, kotha namana khan ke thik rasta dikha bo para hobo lage.

segments.source: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

segments.source: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.
segments.reference: Eitu khan ke rukhai dibole dorkar ase. Taikhan sorom kamai lobo nimite ghor-ghor ke sikhai thake.

segments.source: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”
segments.reference: Taikhan majot te ekjon bhabobadi asele kun pora koi rakhise, “Creta laga manu to sob misa koi thake, aru dusto janwar aru alsi kha-kuwa khan ase.”

segments.source: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,
segments.reference: Etu gawahi hosa ase, karone taikhan ke kara pora koi thakibi, taikhan biswas te thik thaki bole nimite,
segments.hypothesis: Etu kotha to hosa ase. Etu nimite taikhan ke bhal pora dhoribi, titia taikhan laga biswas to bhal hoi jabo.

segments.source: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.
segments.reference: aru taikhan ke Yehudi laga kotha khisa khan aru hosa ke namani kene ghuri juwa khan laga piche jabo nadibi.
segments.hypothesis: Yehudi khan laga kotha khan aru hosa pora ghumai thaka manu khan laga hukum khan ke huni bole na koribi.

segments.source: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
segments.reference: Mon sapha thaka khan nimite hoile sob bostu to sapha ase, kintu sapha nathaka aru biswas nakora khan nimite hoile eku bhi sapha nai, kintu taikhan laga dimag aru bhabona te bhi sob letera ase.

segments.source: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.
segments.reference: Taikhan Isor ke jane koi, kintu kaam te hoile taike namane. Taikhan ke to ghin kori bole lage aru taikhan kotha namana khan ase aru eku bhal kaam kori bole thik nohoi.
segments.hypothesis: Taikhan Isor ke jane koi ase koi kene koi ase, kintu taikhan laga kaam pora Taike namani ase, taikhan ekta bhal kaam kora manu nohoi, aru biya kaam kora manu ase.

segments.source: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
segments.reference: Kintu tumi to hoile, ki kotha koi, etu hosa hisab te sikhai di thakibi.
segments.hypothesis: Kintu hosa kotha ke thik koribi,

segments.source: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,
segments.reference: Bura manu khan ke gusa nauthi bole, bhal bhabona kori bole, nijorke nomro kori bole, biswas te thaki bole, morom kori bole, aru dhorjo pora thaki bole sikhai dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Bosa manu khan ke bhal hoi kene thaki bole dibi, taikhan bhal hoi kene thaki bole dibi, taikhan laga biswas, morom, aru dukh thaki bole nimite thaki bole dibi.

segments.source: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,
segments.reference: Etu nisena dangor umor thaka mahila khan ke bhi pobitro jibon laga bhal niyom thakibo nimite sikhabi, misa kotha kowa aru draikha ros piya nohobo lage, etu bodli, ki bhal ase etu dusra khan ke hikai thaki bole sikhai dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu nisena, dangor maiki khan bhi bhal kaam kori kene thaki bole dibi. Taikhan manu khan ke kotha kotha kobole thakibo, aru bisi kha luwa laga nokorkhan nohobi, kintu bhal kaam khan ke sikhai bole thakibo lage.

segments.source: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,
segments.reference: Etu nisena jawan mahila khan ke tai laga mota aru bacha ke kineka morom koribo lage, etu sikhai dibi,
segments.hypothesis: etu nimite bacha maiki khan ke taikhan laga mota khan aru bacha khan ke morom kori bole sikhai dibo.

segments.source: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
segments.reference: bhal bhabona thaka, sapha mon thaka, nijor mota laga kotha mani thaka, sapha hoi nijor ghor kaam te bhal thaka mahila khan hobole sikhai dibi, tinehoile Isor laga pobitro kotha ke hinsa nohobo.
segments.hypothesis: taikhan nijor laga bhabona te thik thakibo, sapha thakibo, ghor te kaam kori bole, bhal kaam kori bole, nijor laga mota laga kotha te thik thaki bole, titia Isor laga kotha ke biya nathakibo.

segments.source: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
segments.reference: Aru etu nisena jawan manu ke bhal kaam kori bole samjai dibi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu nisena bacha khan ke bhi mon dangor thaki bole mon dangor koribi.

segments.source: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
segments.reference: Tumi laga sob kaam te bhal namuna he dikhai dibi. Aru tumi ki sikhai ase etu hosa aru sapha pora kowa kotha hobo lage,

segments.source: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
segments.reference: juntu hosa kotha ase aru junke eku golti dibo na paribo, eneka hoile kun tumike digdar diye, taikhan sorom hobo, ki karone taikhan pora amikhan laga eku bhi biya kobo na paribo.
segments.hypothesis: Aru bhal kotha khan ke manibo nadibo, titia kun pora apuni khan ke dhori loise taikhan nijorke mon dangor koribo, kele koile amikhan uporte biya kotha kowa nai.

segments.source: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,
segments.reference: Sewak khan ke sob kaam te malik laga kotha mani thaki bole sikhai dibi, khushi pora aru eku jhagara nakori kene,

segments.source: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
segments.reference: nijor malik laga eku chor nakori kene aru sob bhal kaam to biswas pora dikhai dibole nimite sikhai dibi, eneka korile bhal naam to amikhan laga Tran-korta Isor pora sikhai diya kotha ke pabo.
segments.hypothesis: aru dukh nathakibi, kintu sob bhal pora biswas koribi, titia taikhan amikhan laga Poritran Isor laga kotha ke sob te sonman kori bole paribo.

segments.source: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

segments.hypothesis: Kelemane Isor laga anugrah to dikhai dise, aru etu pora sob manu khan ke bachai dibo.

segments.source: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

segments.source: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

segments.source: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
segments.reference: Jisu he amikhan ke niyom namana paap pora udhar koribo nimite nijor jibon daan dise, aru Tai nijor nimite pobitro kori kene ekta jati bonai loise, kunkhan bhal kaam kori bole khushi kore.
segments.hypothesis: Tai amikhan nimite nijorke di dise, etu nimite amikhan ke sob biya kaam pora bachai dibo, aru Tai nijor nimite ekjon manu khan ke sapha kori dibo, kun bhal kaam kori bole mon dangor ase.

segments.source: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
segments.reference: Girja te etu kotha khan sikai dibi, aru manu sobke eitu khan kori bole mon dangor kori dibi, aru adhikar thaka hisab te golti kora khan ke sidha kori bhi. Kun pora bhi apuni ke hisab nathaka hobo nadibi.
segments.hypothesis: Etu kotha khan koi dibi, aru mon dangor koribi, aru sob niyom pora taikhan ke chutu koribi. Kun bhi apuni ke chutu kori bole nadibi.

segments.source: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

segments.hypothesis: Taikhan ke bisar koribi, hukum kora khan aru cholawta khan laga kotha mani kene thakibi, taikhan laga kotha mani kene thakibi, sob bhal kaam kori bole taiyar hoi jabi.

segments.source: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.
segments.reference: kunke bhi bodnam nakoribole aru jhagara nakoribole, kintu sob logote nomro aru bhal niyom pora thaki bole.
segments.hypothesis: kunke bhi biya kotha na koribi, kotha kotha kora manu nohoi, mon dangor thakibi, sob manu logote mon dangor thakibi.

segments.source: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
segments.reference: Kilekoile amikhan bhi ekta somoite eku bhabona nathaka aru kotha namana thakise. Amikhan mangso laga itcha pora dhori kene harai ja khan thakise. Amikhan paap kori thakise aru dusra ke suku joli thakise. Amikhan bisi ghin thakise aru ekjon- ekjon ke bhi ghin kori thakisele.
segments.hypothesis: Kilekoile amikhan bhi ekta age te murkho aru namana manu khan asele, amikhan ke thogai dise. Amikhan sob pora ekjon-ekjon ke morom kori thakise. Amikhan biya kaam kori thakise, aru ekjon-ekjon ke jibon kori thakise, aru ekjon-ekjon ke jibon kori thakise.

segments.source: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
segments.reference: Hoile bhi jitia Udhar-korta Isor laga morom manu uporte dikhai dise,
segments.hypothesis: Kintu jitia amikhan laga Poritran Isor laga morom aru manu khan nimite Tai laga morom dikhai dise,

segments.source: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,
segments.reference: juntu amikhan laga kaam aru dharmikta pora nohoi, kintu Tai laga anugrah pora poritran anidise, aru Pobitro Atma dwara notun jonom aru notun jibon dise,
segments.hypothesis: amikhan nijor laga dharmik kaam pora nohoi, kintu Tai laga morom pora amikhan ke bachai dise, aru Pobitro Atma pora amikhan ke bachai dise.

segments.source: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;
segments.reference: amikhan laga Udhar-korta Jisu Khrista karone Pobitro Atma amikhan ke bhorta haali dise,
segments.hypothesis: Isor pora Jisu Khrista, amikhan laga Poritran dwara amikhan uporte bhal pora dhuri dise.

segments.source: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
segments.reference: etu nimite Tai laga anugrah karone amikhan ke dhormik bonai kene anonto jibon laga asha te Tai laga uttoradhikari bonai dibo karone.
segments.hypothesis: Tai laga anugrah pora amikhan ke dharmik hobole nimite, amikhan nimite anonto jibon laga asha te thaki bole nimite.

segments.source: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;
segments.reference: Etu kotha to biswas koribo laga ase. Aru tumikhan ke etu kotha taikhan ke jor pora koi dibole mon ase, etu pora kunkhan Isor ke biswas korise, taikhan bhal kaam te mon dikene kori thakibo nimite. Etu kotha to bhal aru sob karone labh ase.

segments.source: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
segments.reference: Kintu misa-misi kotha koi thaka, aru khandan khan khisa, aru jhagara kora, aru niyom laga kotha nimite jhagara kora sob to chari di bhi kele koile eitu khan eku labh nai.

segments.source: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

segments.source: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

segments.source: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

segments.source: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
segments.reference: Aru biswasi khan bhi bhal kaam kori bole hiki bo lage, aru bisi ki dorkar ase, etu te modot dibo paribo nimite, aru eneka hoile eku kaam nathaka nohobo.
segments.hypothesis: Amikhan laga manu khan bhi bhal kaam khan kori bole jani bole dibi, titia taikhan bhal phol nathakibo.

segments.source: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.
segments.reference: Ami logote thaka sob pora tumike salam janai ase. Salam di ase jun manu khan biswas te amikhan ke morom kori ase. Apuni khan sob logote Isor laga anugrah thakibo dibi.

segments.source: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

segments.hypothesis: Aphia, ami laga morom kora, aru Archippus, amikhan laga ekjon sipahi, aru apuni laga ghor te thaka girja ke.

segments.source: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
